content.overview: Article 40 directs the State to take steps to organise village panchayats and endow them with powers and authority to function as units of self-government.

sections.heading: Directive content
sections.body: Supports democratic decentralisation at the village level. Implementation is legislative and administrative (including post-73rd Amendment local-government frameworks where applicable — verify the current statutory scheme).

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Implement through statute or scheme. Article 37 bars treating this Directive Principle as a freestanding justiciable right. Verify official text.
